query_payload.rationale: Add packing, compressed-contact, local bonding and angular descriptors beyond Magpie; expand sparse light-element, halide and rare-earth/actinide coverage.
Add packing, bond strain, coordination, polarity and C/N homobond descriptors beyond Magpie; sample C-, N- and F-containing chemistries highlighted by validation errors.
Add packing, contact strain, local chemistry and geometry beyond Magpie. Sample nonoxide C/N/Si/P compounds, halides and underrepresented binaries.
Add packing, local coordination, bond chemistry and atomic-energy descriptors beyond Magpie; sample light-element networks, metalloids and sparsely represented actinides.
Complement Magpie with packing, local geometry and contact chemistry; sample covalent chemistries and sparse heavy elements implicated by current errors.
Add packing, contact strain, local chemical order and charge-transfer descriptors absent from Magpie; sample covalent, f-element and halide-rich chemistries.
Bond geometry, local ionicity, packing and C/N connectivity complement composition. Queries enrich C/N, halide and f-block chemistries.
Add packing, local geometry, bond chemistry and atomic-energy descriptors beyond Magpie; sample C/N, halides and heavy-element chemistries highlighted by validation errors.
Add packing, contact strain, local chemistry and angular order beyond Magpie; sample C/N, halide/pnictogen and heavy-element chemistries highlighted by validation errors.
Add packing, contact strain, local chemistry and angular order; sample C/N, halides and f-element chemistries highlighted by validation.
Retain density/overlap; add radius-scaled bonding, local ionicity, coordination, and atomic energies. Sample light-element networks, halides, and sparse heavy-element chemistry.
Add smooth coordination, chemical ordering, atomic-energy spread and angular geometry. Target carbon, nitrogen, bromides and rare-earth/actinide chemistry.
Combine packing, bond saturation, chemical ordering, angular geometry and charge-transfer physics; prioritize carbon, nitrogen and f-block coverage around large residuals.
Add covalent strain, local polarity, coordination, molecularity and periodic connectivity. Prioritize scarce C/N examples and heavy-element/halide coverage.
Retain current terms; add radius-scaled coordination, distortion, angular order and network dimensionality. Sample mixed oxides, heavy nonoxides and light-element analogues available in the pool.
Add coordination, normalized bond strain, directional order and local polarity; sample f-block, mixed-oxygen and sparse nonoxide chemistries.
Add packing, coordination deficits, shell gaps and directional chemistry to resolve strained or molecular environments. Sample scarce heavy elements, covalent chemistries and simple halides.
Retain electronic terms; add packing, coordination, shell separation and bond geometry for atypical networks. Sample covalent and sparse heavy-element chemistries alongside uniform coverage.
Add packing, coordination heterogeneity, angular order and pair-isolation signals. Sample heavy-element and covalent chemistries highlighted by validation errors.
Add coordination, packing, angular anisotropy and atomic-energy charge-transfer descriptors; sample covalent chemistries, fluorides and sparse f-block chemistry.

final_fill.method: uniform without replacement on remaining POOL; fixed arm/seed RNG
